deploy-bot: Canary rollout v2026.05.08 to us-east1 finished. Starting post-deploy smoke (http/gate, tls, prefill) across canary nodes.
synth-bot: HTTP PROBE WARNING: tls handshake failures for prefill_probe on us-canary-7 (30s window) — 24 failures. sample error: "tls: handshake failure (unknown certificate)"
nina: confirming - we rotated certs in the proxy upgrade (PR #4780). did the cert bundle include canary node certs?
omar: looking at proxy logs: `kubectl -n proxy logs proxy-us-canary-7 -c envoy --since=10m | grep TLS` shows repeated `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` against upstream host `inference-internal:443`.
patrick: that upstream is an internal service that uses mTLS with node-attested certs. the cert rotation added a new CA in the bundle but we accidentally dropped the old CA for a short window during packaging.
qa-bot: impact: canary prefill probes failing only on us-canary-7; other canaries ok. user-facing generate routes show no errors yet.
sre: two mitigation choices: (A) route-pin canary away from the new proxy (fast revert), (B) reapply correct CA bundle to proxy config on canary nodes (targeted hotfix). Which has lower risk?
nina: reapplying CA is safe but needs restart of proxy pods; could cause brief connection churn. pinning routing avoids restarts. Prefer pin+hotfix.
omar: agree. I'll prepare a targeted config revert for the proxy on canary: `kubectl apply -f proxies/ca-bundle-prev.yaml --namespace=proxy --selector=canary=true` and follow with a rolling restart. ETA ~10min.
patrick: if we pin, do pinned variant and run synth recheck. We'll also pre-warm the certificate path after fix.
deploy-bot: Applying route pin: canary -> previous proxy routing variant rwd-proxy-v1@sha256:prevCA for /v1/prefill and /v1/health. Change applied.
synth-bot: POST-PIN PROBE: prefill_probe now 0 tls failures in last 60s on us-canary-7; other canaries unaffected.
qa-bot: starting a 10m soak on prefills to ensure certificate path stable before resuming rollout.
sre: reapplying CA bundle now and will monitor. command: `kubectl -n proxy set-file configmap/proxy-ca ca.pem=./bundles/ca-bundle-full.pem && kubectl -n proxy rollout restart ds/proxy`
omar: CA reapply complete; proxies restarting. no errors in startup; downstream mTLS connections established.
nina: great. please update ENG-3622 with root cause (packaging dropped old CA) and remediation (improve packaging test to verify CA chain).
patrick: i'll cut hotfix PR to add CA bundle validation to CI and include a quick smoke in our release gate. ETA 2h for PR + CI.
deploy-bot: Rollout note appended: temporary route pin for prefill/health in canary, CA bundle re-applied, synth soak passed. Leaving thread open until hotfix merged.
